official.deadline_central_display: 20 February 2026 (2026 cycle closed; next cycle expected 10 January - 20 February 2027)
official.application_cycle: 2026 cycle (applications 10 January - 20 February 2026); one annual application period every year
official.status_note: The 2026 round closed on 20 February 2026; YTB states the general application period is 10 January - 20 February every year, with evaluation March-April, interviews April-June and results in early August.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Official wording: 'Covers tuition fees' and 'your university tuition is covered by Türkiye Scholarships'; undergraduate dormitory fees are also covered.
benefits: Monthly stipend of 6,500 TL (undergraduate), 9,500 TL (master's) or 13,000 TL (PhD)
Tuition fee coverage at the host university
Accommodation: dormitory fees covered for undergraduates; graduates housed in year one, then a housing allowance of 6,000 TL (Istanbul/Ankara) or 5,000 TL (other cities)
Once-off flight ticket on first arrival and on return after graduation
One year of free Turkish language education (TÖMER centres)
University and department placement by YTB, with up to 12 programme choices in TBBS
Academic, social and cultural programmes and the International Student Academy
eligibility: Graduates, or those graduating at the end of the current academic year (before August)
Ineligible: Turkish citizens and individuals who have lost Turkish citizenship
Ineligible: candidates currently enrolled in a Turkish university programme at the level applied for
Age limits: under 21 (associate/bachelor's), under 30 (master's), under 35 (PhD), under 50 (Research Scholarship)
Minimum academic achievement: 70% (associate/bachelor's), 75% (graduate), 90% (Health Sciences - Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy)
requirements: Online application through the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS), free of charge
PhD applicants must submit a research topic proposal and a written example of research carried out
All awardees without a C1 Turkish proficiency certificate must complete the one-year Turkish course and reach C1
Merit Scholarship additionally requires GWA 90%, set exam scores (SAT/ALES/GRE) and TOEFL/IELTS plus top-10 national exam rank or a recognised science olympiad medal
documents: Valid identity document, ID card or passport
Candidate photograph taken within the last year
International exam results (GRE, GMAT, SAT, etc.) if required by the chosen university or programme
International language test results (e.g. TOEFL, DELF) if required by the chosen university or programme
Research topic proposal and written example of research (PhD applications only)
selection_criteria: Documentary evaluation followed by an interview period
Competitive and merit-based, emphasising academic excellence
Evaluation March-April, interviews April-June, results announced early August
coverage: Accommodation (dormitory fees, or housing allowance at graduate level)
application_method: Register and apply online free of charge through TBBS at tbbs.turkiyeburslari.gov.tr
Upload all required documents to the system during the application window
Select up to 12 university/department choices offered to the candidate in the system
official.application_route: Apply free of charge online through the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS) during the annual 10 January - 20 February window.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to citizens of all countries; Turkish citizens and former Turkish citizens are ineligible, as are candidates already enrolled at a Turkish university at the level applied for.
official.international_eligibility: Open to international students from all countries; the programme is designed for non-Turkish applicants worldwide.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Graduate (master's/PhD) scholarships are not awarded in health sciences; the Art Scholarship Programme is limited to named departments at Ankara Music and Fine Arts University, Ankara Haci Bayram Veli University and Istanbul Technical University.
official.research_requirement: PhD applicants must upload a proposal for a research topic and a written example of research they have carried out.
official.duration: Full-time associate, bachelor's, master's and PhD degree programmes
official.description: Türkiye Scholarships is a government-funded, competitive scholarship programme run under the coordination of the Presidency of Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB) that provides international students with tuition support, a monthly stipend, accommodation, health insurance, a once-off flight ticket, a one-year Turkish language course and university placement, aiming to build a network of future leaders committed to cooperation among countries.
official.english_requirement: Not required for the general scholarship; internationally accepted language certificates (TOEFL or equivalent) are needed only where the chosen university or programme requires them, and the Merit Scholarship requires TOEFL IBT 80 (undergraduate) or 90 (graduate) or IELTS 6.5/7.0.

applicant_utility.summary: This is one of the few government scholarship programmes that assigns your university and department for you, so research effort is better spent on making the strongest possible TBBS application than on cold-emailing admissions offices. The stipend scales sharply by level (6,500 TL undergraduate, 9,500 TL master's, 13,000 TL PhD), so doctoral applicants get the strongest package; every scholar without C1 Turkish must still complete the one-year language course before degree study begins. Applications are free, but the window is a narrow 10 January - 20 February each year and the interview round does not start until April-June, so plan a gap of roughly six months between submission and a decision.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Students from any country (except Turkish citizens) with 70-90%+ academic records who want a fully funded degree in Türkiye and are comfortable with YTB choosing the university and department.
application_readiness_checklist: Prepare passport, diploma or temporary graduation certificate, transcript and a photograph taken within the last year before the window opens on 10 January
Check your age against your level's cut-off (under 21 for bachelor's, under 30 master's, under 35 PhD) using your age on the application date
Masters and PhD applicants: line up GRE/GMAT/SAT or ALES results early if your intended host programme may require them
PhD applicants: draft the research topic proposal and written research example before December - these cannot be improvised in the final week
Choose your 12 TBBS programme options deliberately, remembering you can only pick from programmes the system offers you
common_rejection_risks: Being a Turkish citizen or having lost Turkish citizenship - an absolute bar that no strength of record overcomes
Already being enrolled at a Turkish university at the level applied for
Missing the age cut-off (the rule is applied by level, and PhD applicants turning 36 lose eligibility entirely)
Weak academic average below the 70%/75%/90% thresholds for your level
Incomplete uploads - the TBBS form is documentary, so a missing transcript or expired photo stalls evaluation before it starts
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The programme covers tuition, dormitory or housing allowance, health insurance and flights, but the TL stipend is modest against personal spending, visa fees, and the cost of settling in before the first payment; graduate students who leave the dormitory after year one may find the 5,000-6,000 TL housing allowance tight in Istanbul or Ankara.
document_audit: The photograph must have been taken within the last year - older passport-style photos are a common rejection
Graduating students must graduate before August of the application year; a delayed certificate invalidates the application
Any document not issued in Turkish or English needs a certified translation before upload
alerts: The 2026 window closed on 20 February 2026; the next cycle is expected to open 10 January 2027 - there is no rolling or late entry
Turkish language study is compulsory for anyone without C1, which effectively adds a year before degree coursework
Research Scholarships and Success Scholarships (October-November window) are separate programmes with their own deadlines - do not wait for the general round if you are a researcher
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on TBBS during the 10 January - 20 February window, complete the form, upload all documents, select up to 12 offered programmes, then await documentary evaluation (March-April), interviews (April-June) and results in early August.
